observed: The "before the release" side comes from production (app.shopview.com, build v26.45.3, the version before this release; no note was taken on the QA site before the release was installed): two $25.00 credit memos dated 11 Nov 2026 (CM1-4412, CM1-4413) are in "1-30 days past due" on A/R Aging Detail as of 11 Nov 2026.
Step 1 (QA site, with the release): A/R Aging Detail as of 11/11/2026 with every bucket expanded - credit memo CM11315-4319, dated 11 Nov 2026 ($-30.00), is in "Current", not in "1-30 days past due".
So from this release a credit dated exactly on the as-of date is Current, where before the release it counted in 1-30 days past due.
